_comment: Argument/essay attacker/proposer pair (prompts/argument-attacker.md, prompts/argument-proposer.md). Reuses the generic vibe-app pairing mode. Claude proposes, GPT attacks, both via OpenRouter (one OPENROUTER_API_KEY). The pair is deliberately cross-vendor: this mode has a panel of ONE, so there is no second reviewer to catch a same-family attacker's blind spots. GPT takes the attacker seat because this persona hunts named fallacies and broken inferential steps — the most reasoning-heavy of the five services, and the one where a missed step costs the most. Pass --tier to override both. Run: `node orchestrate.mjs --config agents.argument.json --task "..."` (or --file). Converges when the attacker's strongest standing finding is at/below --floor (default LOW).
